sentence_stem: My sister, who lives in Lisbon,
correct_completion: is coming to visit us next week.
full_sentence: My sister, who lives in Lisbon, is coming to visit us next week.
acceptable_variants: is planning to visit us next week.
will come and see us soon.

options.text: which is a very old city.
options.why_wrong: 'Which' refers to the city, not the sister. A non-defining clause must add information about the person already named.

options.text: is coming to visit us next week.

options.why_wrong: 'That' cannot introduce a non-defining clause, and the content does not relate to the sister.
'Because' introduces a cause, not extra information about the sister, so it does not complete the clause.

explanation: A non-defining relative clause adds extra information about a person who is already identified, and it is set off by commas. Learners may drop the relative pronoun or leave out the commas, so keep 'who' and both commas.
translation: Minha irmã, que mora em Lisboa, vem nos visitar na próxima semana.
